name: Knight of the Jewels
description: Plays a cutscene when a Knight of the Jewels is freed by destroying the barrier. Requires a Giant Generator Effect (GNEF) object to function.

fields.name: Knight Index
fields.description: Selects which Knight of the Jewels is freed.

fields.name: Cutscene End Variable
fields.description: The local variable set when the cutscene ends.

fields.name: Activation Variable
fields.description: The local variable that activates the cutscene.
